game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Firewood Stacks, towering firewood stacks: the frost mage must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Library Builder: Combine small functions into a reusable library the frost mage calls throughout the level.
theme: Snowy Hold – Firewood Stacks: towering firewood stacks
core_gameplay_loop: In Firewood Stacks, repeat each round: Combine small functions into a reusable library the frost mage calls throughout the level. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the library value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 14 consecutive correct decisions about library to power up the frost mage and open the frozen well.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 10 (extended tier): Library Builder
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Library Builder' (Week 6 slot 14), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Firewood Stacks'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how library changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Firewood Stacks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 14.
